explanation: W = 1.2 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold (W_thr ~= 1.4861 GeV, i.e. m_p + m_eta). At this W the eta+proton final state has no available phase space, so the process is kinematically forbidden and no radiative-corrections calculation can be performed. Preflight also confirms the eta lookup table only covers W in [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV, consistent with the threshold. To proceed, choose W >= 1.4961 GeV (safely above threshold) at Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*) = 0, phi* = 90 deg, or clarify if a different channel (e.g. pion) or kinematics was intended.
